title: Pertussis
text:
Use the tabs below to switch between the interactive map and the corresponding LGA data table.

MapData table


Use the year selector in the upper-right corner of the map to switch between 2024 and 2025.
Use the mouse, trackpad or map controls to zoom and pan. Hover over an LGA to view its notification rate.




Use the selectors above the table to filter records by year of diagnosis and state or territory.
You can also search by LGA name, LGA code, state or territory, and select a column heading to change the table’s sort order.





Dummy footnote 1: Notification rates are presented per 100,000 population.
Dummy footnote 2:LGAs shaded grey do not have an available notification rate for the selected year.

title: Disease Notification Rates
text:
This website presents interactive disease notification-rate information by Australian local government area (LGA).
Select a disease from the panel on the left to open its disease-specific page. Where multiple years are available, use the year selector to switch between them.
Interactive disease pages may include two views:

title: Disease Notification Rates
text:
Data interpretation
[Dummy text] Notification rates are presented per 100,000 population. Rates based on small notification counts should be interpreted with appropriate caution.
[Dummy text] LGAs shaded grey on a map do not have an available notification rate for the selected year.
